economic_hypothesis: In a causally known BULL market and healthy industry, at least one prior limit-up close identifies revealed leader demand. An 8%-20% pullback whose recent turnover contracts versus its prior twenty-session norm represents supply decay. The first upper-location close through the completed five-day pullback ceiling is a simple second-wave demand trigger.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open
industry: same-day median ret20>0 and positive-ret20 share>50%
leader_identity: at least one limit-up close in preceding20 completed sessions

market.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
market.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
market.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
market.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

pullback: previous close is 8%-20% below preceding20 high

rules.R3_MULTI_LIMIT_LEADER: R1 and at least two prior20 limit-up closes

trigger.cooldown: first retained signal per symbol in each causal 20-session window
trigger.reacceleration: current close first exceeds preceding5 high; step return>=3%; close location>=70%; turnover>=preceding5 mean
